phases.title: Install bcryptjs and jsonwebtoken npm dependencies
phases.notes: Installed bcryptjs@3.0.3 and jsonwebtoken@9.0.3 as dependencies; @types/bcryptjs and @types/jsonwebtoken as devDependencies.

phases.title: Create DB migration src/db/migrations/004_users.sql
phases.notes: Created 004_users.sql with users table (id, email, username, password, created_at). Build passes; auth test failures are expected as endpoints not yet implemented.

phases.title: Create Zod auth schemas in src/schemas/authSchema.ts
phases.notes: Created authSchema.ts with registerSchema (email, username, password min 8) and loginSchema (email, password). Build passes.

phases.title: Create auth service src/services/authService.ts (register, login, getById)
phases.notes: Created authService.ts with register (bcrypt hash, UUID, UNIQUE conflict detection), login (bcrypt compare, AuthError on mismatch), and getById. Build passes; auth test failures are expected as routes/middleware not yet wired up.

phases.title: Create JWT middleware src/middleware/requireJwt.ts
phases.notes: Created requireJwt.ts: extracts Bearer token from Authorization header, verifies with jwt.verify using JWT_SECRET, attaches decoded payload as req.jwtUser, returns 401 on missing/invalid/expired token. Extended express.d.ts to add jwtUser field. Build passes cleanly; auth test 404s are expected since routes not yet mounted (phase 6).

phases.title: Create auth controller, routes, and mount /api/auth in app.ts
phases.notes: Created authController.ts (registerHandler, loginHandler, meHandler), authRoutes.ts (POST /register, POST /login, GET /me with requireJwt), and mounted /api/auth in app.ts. All 34 tests pass, build clean.

phases.title: Run tests and verify all backend tests pass
phases.notes: All 34 tests pass (2 test files). Build completes cleanly with tsc.
